Name: Generous Gus
Author: Kantrip
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#f6b26b]"﻿I don't want anyone in Pelican Town to go hungry[/color][/b][b][color=#f6b26b]." -- Gus[/color][/b]
[/size]
[size=4]At least, that's what Gus says to Linus when he catches the mountain-dweller digging through trash cans in town. But then, why doesn't Gus ever offer food to the hungry player?
[/size]
[size=5][b][color=#f6b26b]Generous Gus[/color][/b] [/size][size=4]is a mod that changes all of that![/size]

[b][color=#f6b26b][size=5]Now Gus will: [/size][/color]
[/b][size=4]* [b][color=#ffe599]Offer food to new players[/color][/b] (1x per day, for the first two weeks)
* [b][color=#ffe599]Give food to players who are at 200 gold or less[/color][/b] (1x per day)
* [b][color=#ffe599]Serve warm soup to the player after their first mine death[/color][/b]
* [b][color=#ffe599]Celebrate upcoming births/adoptions with the player[/color][/b] (1x per day during expecting period)
* [b][color=#ffe599]Congratulate new couples with a wedding gift![/color][/b]

Also includes [color=#ffe599][b]three charitable quests[/b][/color] from Gus :)[/size]


[b][color=#f6b26b][size=4]Included Translations:[/size][/color]
[/b][size=4]* Spanish -- credit and thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/devy003]devy003[/url]
* Russian -- credit and thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Bromgek]Bromgek
[/url]* Chinese -- credit and thanks to [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/coucou0610][size=4]coucou0610[/size][/url]

Manifest.Description: Gus will pick you up when you're feeling down.
